from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowEntry(BaseModel):
    """A single cash flow line item extracted from one financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by the statement, e.g. '2022'")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact description of the line item (e.g. 'Net cash provided by financing activities')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The monetary amount as a signed float; parentheses or 'used' indicate negative values")
    is_net_position: bool = Field(description="True if this line represents the total net change in cash for the period, False for components (Operating/Investing/Financing)")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text from the document anchoring this entry")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_entries: list[CashFlowEntry]
